theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_zero_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U B K : Set (Euclid P)) (hBU : B ⊆ U) (X : GeometricCurrentOn B n) (R : IMRep B n), IsOpen B → IsCompact K → K ⊆ B → R.Represents X → (∀ y ∈ B, y ∉ K → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ R.measure (ball y ρ) = 0) → ∃ E : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity E ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn B n, E (testFormOnInclusion hBU n ω) = X ω) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) K → E ω = 0
